data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2020 the syndicate carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 821.6m. Analysis of the claims development triangle indicates a small net gross adverse movement on prior years of approximately GBP 10.7m (1.3% of opening gross reserves) driven by mixed developments across older underwriting years. The management commentary highlights net adverse development of GBP 26.6m (net of reinsurance) related to deterioration across a number of prior years; this net adverse outcome was materially influenced by changes in reinsurance recoverables. Key lines affected include Marine/Transport, Third Party Liability (Casualty), Property and Accident & Health.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year reserve movement (gross PYD) is not explicitly stated in a single 'movement in prior year provision' gross figure. A gross claims development triangle is available and was used to calculate gross prior-year development (+10.7m). The management narrative states a net adverse prior-year development of GBP 26.6m (net of reinsurance); that net figure was explicitly stated but a gross equivalent was not provided. RITC and quota-share/SPA cessions and commutations materially affected reinsurance recoverables during the year and therefore net movements differ substantially from gross movements. Where net figures were the only explicit statements, the gross triangle was used as the primary calculation source and the use of the net figure is noted here.
